supersedes.reason: An independent full-file analysis of the exact target found 79,782 potential starts from three separately auditable evidence classes. The dashboard now uses the broader candidate universe so those 766 candidates are not silently excluded from total-work accounting.

policy: Use 79,782 as the decompilation dashboard candidate denominator. Retain 79,016 as the stricter V5 high-confidence CFG cross-check. Do not describe either value as an exact original C/C++ source-symbol function count without the matching PDB/MAP or equivalent authoritative metadata.
